name: @red-cup-engineering/infomaterial-layout-service
description: Exact carrier-layout assay joining reusable M1 circuit definitions and one sovereign assembly to one recursive infomaterial cover.

scripts.check: node --check src/layout-assay.mjs && node --check src/client.mjs && node --check src/law.mjs && node --check bin/execute-a2a-task.mjs && node --check bin/server.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one placement-neutral M1 circuit family, one exact sovereign assembly, one recursive material cover, and one mechanically refinement-gated carrier for every mount
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: layout gaps or overlaps, function labels, absent independent refinement, carrier/material/component drift, uncarried definitions, embedded occurrence identity, inferred cuts, child-circuit-interior reads, carrier retention, customer writes, self-attestation, or legacy topology/conductor envelopes

serve-infomaterial-layout-a2a.accepts: application/rmn+cbor HierarchicalInfomaterialLayoutAssayRequest carrying M1 v2 definitions, assembly, cover, observed carriers, and producer identities
